explanation: Answers erdosproblems.com/294's 'estimate t(N)' with the Liu–Sawhney bounds N/((log N)(log log N)³(log log log N)^{O(1)}) ≪ t(N) ≪ N/log N. The O(1) exponent is encoded as an existential real K, which is equivalent. t(N) is the least positive t admitting no Egyptian-fraction representation of 1 with smallest denominator t and all denominators ≤ N.
